title: Why do chemicals in beauty products have a bad reputation? How better science communication can tackle misinformation
summary: In an era of widespread misinformation, inaccurate science communication is rife. In his keynote speech at the CTPA Scientific Conference, Beta Montemayor tackled how the industry can start to rewire the public perception of chemicals
